title: Credited Days Reached by a Coverage-Type Change, TRICARE Reserve Select Early-Duty Month Credit
content:
**Ledger adjustment ruling - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

Which credited days the change in the early-duty month credit applies to follows the period it covers: where the change credit or paid adjustment covers only part of the month, it applies only to the credited days from the first day it covers; where it covers the whole month, it applies to every credited day; otherwise it applies to no credited day.

- The credited days are the days the early-duty month credit credits, from its first counted day through the last day of the month.
- A change credit or adjustment covering part of a month covers the days from the DEERS event date through the last day of that month, so the first day it covers is the day that leaves exactly its covered days to the end of the month.
- The change applies once, at its daily figure, for each credited day it reaches.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, June, 30 days)

| Credited days | Change covers | Credited days the change applies to |
|---|---|---|
| 15 to 30 June | 11 days, 20 to 30 June | 20 to 30 June, 11 days |
| 25 to 30 June | 11 days, 20 to 30 June | 25 to 30 June, 6 days |
| 15 to 30 June | the whole month | 15 to 30 June, 16 days |
| 15 to 30 June | no change credit and no paid adjustment | none |
